test.//: Default (in-process, source-level) lane. Most resource-consuming specs — the integration suites that spawn the built CLI bin, and the java-javalin parity host that needs `apigen-java:package` — live in sibling `*.e2e.ts` files under the on-demand `e2e` target. One exception remains here and is why this target also builds itself: `src/test/e2e/cjs-import-meta-url.spec.ts` reads and spawns this package's own built `dist/index.js` (BUG-BUILD-002 acceptance), so `build` (not just `^build`, which builds only upstream deps) is a hard dependency — without it the spec ENOENTs on a clean checkout. Override of the inferred `test` target carries only `dependsOn` (`lint`/`build`/`^build`) plus `inputs` excluding `*.e2e.ts`; executor/cache/outputs come from inference.
test.//inputs: Exclude *.e2e.ts so editing a resource-consuming suite never invalidates the default lane's cache — it never runs those files (its vitest `include` is `src/**/*.spec.ts`, see vite.config.ts). Mirrors the workspace targetDefaults.test inputs plus the negative pattern.

e2e.//: RESOURCE-CONSUMING lane. REACHABILITY (2026-09-28, backlog-e2e-cache-separation): it is NOT in any `test.dependsOn` (the default lane stays fast), but it IS reached by the push/CI gate's `nx affected -t e2e` — the gate's target list is canonicalised in `tools/gate/lane-gate.mjs` (`GATE_TARGETS = ['test','e2e']`), which `.githooks/pre-push` and both CI workflows consume — and by `publish` via the conditional in `tools/nx-plugins/build/plugin.js` (`hasE2e ? ["e2e"] : []`). It is cached (`cache:true` + `inputs`) so a repeat gate run is a cache HIT, never an uncached re-run. It runs the sibling *.e2e.ts suites via vitest.e2e.config.ts. `dependsOn` is exactly the resource prerequisites those suites need: `build` (most spawn the built dist/index.js) and `apigen-java:package` (java-ts-decimal-parity drives the JVM).
